records.jp: 大丈夫だよ。何？
records.en_original: Yeah, sure. What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, sure. What's up?
records.en: I do. What is it?

records.jp: ちょっと、相談に乗ってほしいことがあって……。<CR>屋上に来てくれる？
records.en_original: I need your advice. Could we go up to the roof?
records.en_auxiliary: I need your advice. Could we go up to the roof?
records.en: There's something I'd like your advice on...<CR>Would you come to the rooftop?

records.jp: それで、相談って……？
records.en_original: So what did you need my advice on?
records.en_auxiliary: So what did you need my advice on?
records.en: So, what did you want advice about...?

records.jp: この前あなたが言ってたことなんだけど……
records.en_original: It's about something you said before.
records.en_auxiliary: It's about something you said before.
records.en: It's about what you said the other day...

records.jp: え、私なんか言ったっけ？
records.en_original: Did I say something?
records.en_auxiliary: Did I say something?
records.en: Huh? Did I say something?

records.jp: 「伶那さんでも、この世界のことはわからないんだ」<CR>って言ってたじゃない？
records.en_original: You said, "So this place is a mystery even to you, huh?" Remember?
records.en_auxiliary: You said, "So this place is a mystery even to you, huh?" Remember?
records.en: "Even Rena-san doesn't understand this world,"<CR>you said, didn't you?

records.jp: あ、いや、それは伶那さんをディスったんじゃなくて
records.en_original: Oh, uh, I wasn't trying to insult your intelligence or anything, I just—
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, uh, I wasn't trying to insult your intelligence or anything, I just—
records.en: Ah, no, I wasn't trying to insult you or anything, Rena-san.

records.jp: わかってる。<CR>でも、その通り
records.en_original: I know. You were right.
records.en_auxiliary: I know. You were right.
records.en: I know.<CR>But it's true.

records.jp: どんなに勉強してもキリがないくらい、<CR>この世界にはわからないことが溢れてる
records.en_original: I could study forever and not even scratch the surface of the mysteries of this world.
records.en_auxiliary: I could study forever and not even scratch the surface of the mysteries of this world.
records.en: There are so many things in this world I don't understand,<CR>to the point that no matter how much I study, there's no end to it.

records.jp: 灰病についても、少しわかったくらいで<CR>根本的には何も解決できなかった
records.en_original: I may have learned about the Ash, but I never even came close to solving it.
records.en_auxiliary: I may have learned about the Ash, but I never even came close to solving it.
records.en: Even with the Ash Disease, I only understood a little,<CR>and in the end I couldn't solve anything fundamental.

records.jp: 勇希を私の手で治すことはできなかった
records.en_original: I couldn't cure Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: I couldn't cure Yuki.
records.en: I couldn't cure Yuki with my own hands.

records.jp: ……ねえ、わたしがやってきたことって<CR>意味があったのかな？
records.en_original: Has... Has everything I've done up to now been meaningless?
records.en_auxiliary: Has... Has everything I've done up to now been meaningless?
records.en: ...Hey, do you think<CR>anything I've done has had any meaning?

records.jp: ないわけないじゃん
records.en_original: Of course not.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course not.
records.en: Of course it has.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: この世界でさ。<CR>どんだけ伶那さんに助けられたかわからないよ
records.en_original: I don't even know how many times you've saved me during our time here.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't even know how many times you've saved me during our time here.
records.en: Here in this world,<CR>I can't even count how much you've helped me, Rena-san.

records.jp: みんなの気を引き締めてくれるのも、<CR>深いところまで考えてくれるのも、全部伶那さん
records.en_original: You help us all focus on the problem at hand, and think harder than all of us put together.
records.en_auxiliary: You help us all focus on the problem at hand, and think harder than all of us put together.
records.en: You're the one who keeps everyone on their toes,<CR>and the one who thinks things all the way through. That's all you, Rena-san.

records.jp: 伶那さんがいなかったら、もっと私たち<CR>ダメになってたって
records.en_original: Without you, we'd be a complete lost cause.
records.en_auxiliary: Without you, we'd be a complete lost cause.
records.en: If Rena-san weren't here,<CR>we'd be in much worse shape.

records.jp: でも、結局みんなを引っ張ってるのは星崎さんで……
records.en_original: But you're the one who leads us, Hoshizaki...
records.en_auxiliary: But you're the one who leads us, Hoshizaki...
records.en: But in the end, the one pulling everyone along is Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: 私だけじゃ無理だったよ
records.en_original: I couldn't do it by myself.
records.en_auxiliary: I couldn't do it by myself.
records.en: I couldn't have done it by myself.

records.jp: ……一人でできることには限界がある。<CR>無意味だって思えることも多いかもしれない
records.en_original: There's a limit to what you can do alone. And there may be lots of things we feel are pointless.
records.en_auxiliary: There's a limit to what you can do alone. And there may be lots of things we feel are pointless.
records.en: ...There's a limit to what one person can do.<CR>There may be lots of things that feel meaningless.

records.jp: でもさ、みんなで力を合わせれば<CR>乗り越えられるんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: But if we all work together, maybe we can overcome this.
records.en_auxiliary: But if we all work together, maybe we can overcome this.
records.en: But if everyone joins forces,<CR>maybe we can overcome it?

records.jp: この世界で、私たちが少しずつ<CR>謎を解いていってるみたいに
records.en_original: We can solve all these mysteries one by one. Together.
records.en_auxiliary: We can solve all these mysteries one by one. Together.
records.en: Just like in this world,<CR>where we're unraveling its mysteries a little at a time.

records.jp: 少なくとも私は――
records.en_original: At the very least—
records.en_auxiliary: At the very least—
records.en: At least, I—

records.jp: 伶那さんがいてくれてよかったって思ってる
records.en_original: I'm so glad that you're here with us.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so glad that you're here with us.
records.en: I'm glad you're here, Rena-san.

records.jp: 一緒に乗り越えていこうよ。<CR>少なくとも私は、協力するからさ
records.en_original: We'll get through this together. If nothing else, I'll be by your side.
records.en_auxiliary: We'll get through this together. If nothing else, I'll be by your side.
records.en: Let's overcome this together.<CR>At least I'll help you.

records.jp: 私だけは信じて
records.en_original: You can trust me.
records.en_auxiliary: You can trust me.
records.en: At least trust me.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Okay.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: <CLGR>伶那<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Rena's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Rena's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked<CR>in <CLGR>Rena's<CLNR> Talents.
